paper_title: Dual Modality-Aware Gated Prompt Tuning for Few-Shot Multimodal Sarcasm   Detection
caption: Effect of Prompt Depth

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between prompt depth and accuracy for two different datasets labeled as "mmsd" and "mmsd2". The x-axis, labeled "Prompt Depth (J)," is on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 12 with tick intervals at every unit. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)", is also on a linear scale, ranging from 74 to 81, with tick intervals at every 1%. The first line represents the dataset labeled "mmsd", featuring an orange color, square markers, and a dashed line style. It starts at an accuracy of 80% at a prompt depth of 1, increases slightly to 81.2 % at depth 9, and then decreases to 80% by depth 10. The second line represents the dataset labeled "mmsd2", shown in blue with circle markers and a solid line style. It begins at an accuracy of 76.5% at depth 1, decreases to 74% at depth 3, then steadily increases to 77.5% at depth 8, before declining slightly to 76.5% at depth 10. A legend is there at the bottom right of the line plot to match different lines to their labels.
